subject: unique() for GRanges list of islands and shores

messages.author: 8b2310c4a535a07b
messages.subject: unique() for GRanges list of islands and shores
parts:
Hey Altuna,

Quick question:

In the manual it is said that for regionCounts:
regions    : a GRanges or GRangesList object. Make sure that the GRanges objects are unique in chr,start,end and strand columns.You can make them unique by using unique() function

I have the following object:
cpg.obj=readFeatureFlank("hg19_cpgi_bed.txt", feature.flank.name=c("CpGi","shores"))

How do I apply unique to the GRanges list that contains islands and shores?

Thank you very much

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] unique() for GRanges list of islands and shores
parts:
They should already be unique, CpG island annotations don't have the same coordinates afaik

Best
Altuna

messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] unique() for GRanges list of islands and shores
parts:
you have to merge GRanges objects that contain shores and CpGi and feed it into the regionCounts

something like reduce(c(cpg.obj$CpGi,cpg.obj$shores)) could work.
reduce merges coordinates that overlap. Sometimes the shores of one CpG island will cover the next one, if they are close by. check reduce() function in GenomicRanges

Best,
Altuna
